welcome.headline: Welcome Ryan
welcome.tagline: Your stay at Monte Christo, beautifully arranged.

compendium.title: Wi-Fi
compendium.body:
Network: MonteCristo-Guest
Password: provided on your welcome card.

Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi reaches every room, the lobby, the pool deck and the gardens. For help connecting smart TVs or game consoles, dial 0 from your room phone.

compendium.title: Check-out
compendium.body:
Standard check-out is 11:00 a.m. Late check-out until 1:00 p.m. is complimentary subject to availability — please request it at the front desk or via the concierge the night before.

Express check-out: leave your key card in the room and we will email your folio.

compendium.title: Concierge
compendium.body:
Available 24 hours. Dial 0 from your room phone or visit the lobby desk between the lifts.

We can arrange dinner reservations at any restaurant in town, private transport, in-room spa treatments, theatre tickets, child-care and bespoke excursions.

compendium.title: Restaurants & Bar
compendium.body:
Atrium — Breakfast 7:00 – 11:00, Dinner 18:00 – 22:00
La Terrasse — Lunch 12:00 – 15:00, Dinner 18:30 – 22:30
The Bar at Monte Christo — 16:00 until late
In-Room Dining — 24 hours

Resident guests enjoy priority seating; please book through the concierge.

compendium.title: Spa & Wellness
compendium.body:
Spa open daily 8:00 – 21:00. Treatments by appointment — dial 0 or visit the spa reception on the lower ground floor.

Sauna, steam room, indoor pool and relaxation lounge are complimentary for resident guests.

compendium.title: Pool
compendium.body:
Outdoor pool open 7:00 until sunset. Towels are provided poolside.
Indoor pool open 6:00 – 22:00.

Pool bar service from 11:00 – 19:00 — wave to a server or scan the QR code on your sun-lounger.

compendium.title: Fitness Centre
compendium.body:
Open 24 hours, located on the lower ground floor next to the spa.

Cardio equipment, free weights, Peloton bikes and a stretch studio. Personal trainers available by appointment via the concierge.

compendium.title: Housekeeping
compendium.body:
Daily turn-down service after 18:00. Hang the privacy card on your door if you would prefer not to be disturbed.

For additional towels, pillows, a humidifier or other amenities, dial 0.

compendium.title: Emergency
compendium.body:
In an emergency dial 9 on your room phone for the duty manager, who will dispatch the appropriate service.

Fire exits are clearly marked on each floor — please review the door card on the inside of your room door for assembly point details.

activities.title: Sunset Sailing
activities.summary: Two-hour catamaran cruise along the coast with sparkling wine and canapés.

activities.title: Snorkel Reef Tour
activities.summary: Guided snorkel trip to a protected reef. All gear and a light lunch provided.

activities.title: Vineyard & Winery
activities.summary: Half-day tour of three local vineyards with tastings and lunch on the estate.

activities.title: Helicopter Coastline
activities.summary: Scenic flight over the cliffs and bays with a Champagne toast on landing.

activities.title: Private Beach Picnic
activities.summary: Reserved beach cabana, chef's hamper, dedicated server and Champagne service.

activities.title: Spa Couples Ritual
activities.summary: Two-hour signature treatment for two in the private spa villa.
